newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends soft as interest rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends soft as interest rates fall.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed marginally softer at 477.35/478.35 per dollar in slow trade as interest rates fell at the Central Bank's weekly auction of TEM paper, so discouraging bolivar purchases, traders said.
Traders said there was moderate to strong demand for dollars during Wednesday's session. "But the Central Bank stopped the rate from slipping too far by selling dollars into the market," said one.
Yields on the Central Bank's six-month TEMs, used as a benchmark for wider interest rates, fell 77 basis points to 18.16 percent at the weekly auction.
